about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Lemon Caper Butter Sauce for Fish
recipes.summary: A quick pan sauce of browned butter, capers, lemon and parsley for grilled or pan-fried fish.
steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat and cook for 2 minutes until foaming and lightly golden.
Add the garlic and capers for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Take off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and parsley and spoon over the fish.
notes: Use the sauce straight away while it is warm.
Rinse the capers if you want less salt.

recipes.title: Garlic and Parsley Compound Butter for Steak
recipes.summary: Soft butter blended with garlic, parsley and lemon zest, melted over hot grilled steak.
steps: Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley, lemon zest and salt in a bowl until smooth.
Roll into a log in baking paper and chill until firm.
Slice a round onto each hot steak just before serving.
notes: Freeze the log for up to 2 months.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mango Salsa for Grilled Fish
recipes.summary: Sweet mango, red onion, chilli and lime with fresh coriander, cool against smoky fish.
steps: Combine the mango, onion, chilli and coriander in a bowl.
Stir in the lime juice and salt until evenly mixed.
Spoon over grilled fish or chicken.
notes: Use firm, ripe mangoes so the pieces hold their shape.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tamarind Barbecue Glaze for Ribs and Chicken
recipes.summary: A sticky, tangy glaze of tamarind, brown sugar, soy and smoked paprika for brushing on the grill.
steps: Warm the oil in a small pan and cook the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Brush over meat in the last 10 minutes of grilling.
notes: Food safety: use fresh glaze for brushing during cooking only and boil any glaze that touched raw meat for 2 minutes before serving.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Miso Glaze for Grilled Fish
recipes.summary: Sweet white miso, mirin and honey, brushed on salmon or eggplant before grilling.
steps: Whisk the miso, mirin, honey and vinegar in a small pan.
Warm over low heat for 2 minutes, stirring, until smooth and glossy.
Stir in the sesame oil and brush onto fish or vegetables before grilling.
notes: Watch closely under the grill, as the sugars catch quickly.
Check the miso label for gluten.

recipes.title: Lemon and Garlic Gremolata
recipes.summary: Chopped parsley, lemon zest and raw garlic in olive oil, a sharp finish for grilled meat and fish.
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic together until almost a paste.
Mix in the lemon zest and salt.
Stir in the oil and spoon over grilled meat or fish.
notes: Make it just before serving for the brightest colour.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chinese Black Vinegar and Chilli Dressing
recipes.summary: A dark, tangy dressing with soy, garlic and chilli oil for cold noodles and cucumber.
steps: Whisk the vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, chilli oil and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Stir in the grated garlic until evenly mixed.
Spoon over salads or noodles and toss until coated.
notes: Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.
Keeps 1 week in the fridge.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass and Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: Fish sauce, lime and fragrant lemongrass for herb salads and rice noodle bowls.
steps: Stir the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Add the lemongrass, chilli, garlic and oil and mix well.
Spoon over noodles, grilled meat or salad.
notes: Contains fish.
Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Tahini Soy Dressing for Cold Noodles
recipes.summary: A nutty, creamy sesame dressing with soy and rice vinegar for cabbage and cold noodle salads.
steps: Whisk the tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Loosen with the water until pourable.
Toss through noodles or cabbage until coated.
notes: Contains sesame, soy and egg.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Thai Tamarind and Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: Sweet, sour and salty tamarind dressing for green mango and papaya salads.
steps: Whisk the tamarind, fish sauce, sugar and lime juice together until the sugar dissolves.
Stir in the chilli and oil.
Toss through salad until coated.
notes: Contains fish.
Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Crispy Fried Shallots
recipes.summary: Golden, crunchy shallots to scatter over rice, noodles, soups and salads.
steps: Pat the shallots dry and put them in a cold pan with the oil.
Heat over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring, until the shallots are deep golden.
Lift out with a slotted spoon onto paper towel and sprinkle with salt, where they crisp as they cool.
notes: Take them out slightly pale, as they keep darkening off the heat.
Store in an airtight jar for 1 week and keep the flavoured oil for cooking.

recipes.title: Hazelnut Dukkah
recipes.summary: Egyptian nut and spice mix of hazelnuts, sesame, coriander and cumin for dipping bread and oil.
steps: Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden, then rub off the skins.
Toast the sesame, coriander and cumin seeds for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Crush or pulse everything with the salt and pepper until coarsely crushed.
notes: Contains tree nuts and sesame.
Keeps 3 weeks in a jar.

recipes.title: Furikake-Style Seed and Seaweed Sprinkle
recipes.summary: A toasted sesame, nori and salt seasoning for rice, eggs and avocado.
steps: Toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Crumble the nori into fine flakes.
Mix with the sugar and salt and tip into a jar.
notes: Contains sesame.
Keeps 1 month in an airtight jar.

recipes.title: Crispy Garlic Chips
recipes.summary: Paper-thin garlic fried until golden, for soups, stir-fries and noodles.
steps: Put the garlic in a cold pan with the oil and heat over medium heat.
Stir for 3 minutes until the garlic is pale gold, then lift out onto paper towel.
Season with the salt and leave to crisp.
notes: Take it off before it browns, as it turns bitter quickly.
Keeps 3 days in a sealed jar.

recipes.title: Toasted Coconut Topping
recipes.summary: Golden coconut flakes with lime zest and a pinch of salt for curries, porridge and salads.
steps: Toast the coconut in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until golden.
Tip into a bowl straight away so it stops cooking.
Mix with the lime zest and salt.
notes: Watch closely, as coconut burns quickly.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Za'atar Breadcrumbs
recipes.summary: Crisp olive-oil crumbs with za'atar for scattering over soups, roast vegetables and pasta.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the breadcrumbs for 4 minutes, stirring, until golden and crisp.
Take the pan off the heat and let the crumbs cool for 1 minute.
Stir through the za'atar and salt while still warm.
notes: Not suitable for gluten-free.
Keeps 3 days in an airtight tin.

recipes.title: Homemade Gomasio Sesame Salt
recipes.summary: Japanese toasted sesame and salt condiment for rice, vegetables and eggs.
steps: Toast the white and black sesame seeds in a dry pan for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and popping.
Tip into a mortar with the salt.
Crush lightly until about half the seeds are broken.
notes: Contains sesame.
Keeps 1 month in a jar.

recipes.title: Crispy Spiced Chickpea Topping
recipes.summary: Oven-roasted smoked paprika chickpeas that crunch over soups and salads.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Toss the chickpeas with the oil, paprika and salt on a tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, shaking once, until crisp and golden.
notes: Eat the same day for the best crunch.
Naturally vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pangrattato Garlic Breadcrumbs
recipes.summary: Italian toasted breadcrumbs with garlic, chilli and parsley for pasta and vegetables.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the breadcrumbs for 4 minutes, stirring, until golden.
Add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute until fragrant.
Take off the heat and stir through the parsley.
notes: Not suitable for gluten-free.
Keeps 3 days in an airtight tin.

recipes.title: Peanut and Chilli Crunch Oil
recipes.summary: A crunchy chilli oil with peanuts, garlic and sesame for dumplings, noodles and eggs.
steps: Warm the oil and garlic in a small pan over low heat for 4 minutes until pale gold.
Add the peanuts and sesame seeds and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir the chilli flakes, soy sauce and sugar into a heatproof bowl and pour over the hot oil until it sizzles.
notes: Contains peanuts and sesame.
Not suitable for gluten-free unless you use tamari.

recipes.title: Apple and Lime Breakfast Smoothie with Mint
recipes.summary: A fresh yoghurt smoothie of apple, lime and mint with a little honey.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend on high for 1 minute until smooth and frothy.
Pour into two tall glasses and drink straight away while cold.
notes: Use a dairy-free yoghurt and milk to make it vegan.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Avocado and Spinach Breakfast Smoothie
recipes.summary: A creamy green smoothie with avocado, apple, spinach and yoghurt.
steps: Add the avocado, spinach, apple, milk, yoghurt and honey to a blender.
Blend for 1 minute until completely smooth.
Pour into two tall glasses and drink straight away while cold.
notes: Drink straight away, as it darkens on standing.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mango and Ginger Breakfast Smoothie
recipes.summary: Mango, yoghurt and orange juice with a warm kick of fresh ginger.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend for 1 minute until smooth.
Pour into two tall glasses and drink straight away while cold.
notes: Use frozen mango for a thicker smoothie.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pear and Ginger Oat Breakfast Smoothie
recipes.summary: A filling smoothie of pear, rolled oats, milk and ginger with a touch of cinnamon.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend for 1 to 2 minutes until the oats are fully broken down and the smoothie is smooth.
Pour into two tall glasses and drink straight away while cold.
notes: Oats can contain traces of gluten.
Use oat milk for a dairy-free version.

recipes.title: Pineapple and Coconut Breakfast Smoothie
recipes.summary: Pineapple, coconut milk and yoghurt blended into a creamy, sunny drink.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend for 1 minute until smooth and creamy.
Pour into two tall glasses and drink straight away while cold.
notes: Shake the coconut milk can before opening.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Orange and Carrot Breakfast Smoothie
recipes.summary: Carrot, orange and yoghurt with ginger and turmeric for a bright morning glass.
steps: Add everything to a blender.
Blend on high for 1 to 2 minutes until the carrot is fully broken down and the smoothie is smooth.
Pour into two tall glasses and drink straight away while cold.
notes: Strain through a sieve for a silky texture.
Naturally gluten-free.
